dict.string: ElioChat reads and creates calendar events so you can ask the AI about your schedule. For example, say "What meetings do I have today?" to see your upcoming events.
ElioChat uses the camera to capture photos for AI analysis. For example, you can take a photo of a document and ask the AI to summarize it.
ElioChat searches your contacts when you ask the AI about people. For example, say "What is Tanaka's phone number?" to look up contact details.
ElioChat uses your current location to answer location-based questions. For example, ask "Where am I right now?" to get your address.
ElioChat uses the microphone to record your voice messages and convert speech to text in conversations. For example, tap the microphone button to dictate a message instead of typing.
ElioChat saves AI-generated images to your photo library. For example, when the AI creates an image, you can tap Save to store it in your Photos.
ElioChat accesses your photo library so you can share images with the AI for analysis. For example, select a photo and ask "What is in this picture?"
ElioChat reads and creates reminders through AI conversation. For example, say "Remind me to take out the trash at 10 AM" to create a new reminder.
ElioChat uses on-device speech recognition to convert your voice into text for AI conversations. For example, speak naturally and see your words appear as a typed message.
